headline: A unit head, not the group CEO: Omnicom names a new chief for its health-marketing business
reasoning: Source: Omnicom's release on PR Newswire: 'appointment of Tom Schwenger as the Chief Executive Officer of its health marketing business, Omnicom Health, effective November 2, 2026 ... He succeeds Dana Maiman'.
What changed: leadership of one division. The group CEO is unchanged.
objections: Division leadership change; immaterial for the group.
